Privacy policy

Draft text, to be reviewed by Lauhata before publishing.

Who we are

This website belongs to Lauhata, a restaurant and accommodation in Lauhata, Liquiçá, Timor-Leste. For questions about your data, use the details on the contact page.

Booking forms

The booking forms do not store data on this website. When you send, the details you entered are placed in a WhatsApp message, which is only sent when you confirm it in the app. From then on, the conversation is subject to WhatsApp's terms.

How we use your data

We use your name, contact and request details only to reply to you and manage your booking.

Visitor statistics

If the website uses Google Analytics, anonymous or aggregated usage data is collected to improve the website. This section will be updated if the tool is switched on.

Third-party services

The map is loaded from Google Maps, and photos and fonts may be loaded from external services, which may log the visitor's IP address.

Your rights

You can ask to see, correct or delete the data you sent us by contacting Lauhata.
